envelope.selection: only at byte zero: the exact mbox line selects the mbox variant, a first line starting exactly 'From: ' selects the header-only variant; never searched for, resynchronized or backtracked to a later diff or separator
envelope.values: framing and bounds only; author, address, date, subject, message and commit id are not interpreted, decoded, retained, hashed or emitted
envelope.acceptance: a named framing match only; not authorship, authenticity, provenance, Git generation, message, diffstat or applicability

grammar: artifact := bare-diff EOF | envelope diff-sections ending
bare-diff := file-section{1..16}; nothing before, between or after
mbox-envelope := mbox-line headers LF message '---' LF [stat-block]
header-only-envelope := from-field [date-field] subject-field LF message '---' LF [stat-block]; selected only when the first line starts 'From: '
headers := from-field date-field subject-field, in that order, once each

from-field := 'From: ' OPAQUE LF continuation*; date-field := 'Date: ' OPAQUE LF continuation*; subject-field := 'Subject: ' OPAQUE LF continuation*; continuation := (SP | HTAB) OPAQUE LF; Date is optional only in the header-only variant
OPAQUE := nonempty printable ASCII and HTAB
message := (printable ASCII, HTAB or empty) LF lines up to the first exact '---' line; the separator is never retried; a diff-looking line before it is message text
separator := '---' LF immediately followed by 'diff --git' or by a stat-block immediately followed by 'diff --git'

stat-block := row{1..16} summary LF; row := ' REL' SP+ '|' SP+ COUNT [' ' [+-]+] LF; summary := ' N file[s] changed' [', N insertion[s](+)'] [', N deletion[s](-)'] LF; framing only, no agreement with hunks
ending := EOF | '-- ' LF VERSION LF EOF, after at least one complete file section; VERSION := N(.N){1..3}, N of 1..3 digits
file-section := 'diff --git a/REL b/REL' LF [index-line] '--- a/REL' LF '+++ b/REL' LF hunk+
body := lines prefixed ' ', '-' or '+', consumed by the declared old and new counts, each optionally followed by '\ No newline at end of file' LF
REL := ASCII 0x21-0x7e without double quote or backslash, components not empty, '.', '..' or '.git'; the same in all four places of a section

coordinate_policy.name: cumulative-boundary-v1
coordinate_policy.expected_new_boundary: old boundary + sum of prior (new_count - old_count)
coordinate_policy.order: old side and new side monotonic and non-overlapping within a file section
coordinate_policy.reset: every file section and every artifact; nothing carries across the series
coordinate_policy.shared_paths: repeated-file participation only; no dependency, order or applicability claim

excluded: any mail framing other than the named envelope and ending
unknown, extra, duplicate or reordered headers; MIME or transfer encodings
cover letter without a diff; PGP; unknown stat block or signature
new, deleted, renamed or copied file

exit_codes.0: every patch matches the structural profile
exit_codes.3: bundle identity matched and at least one patch does not match the profile
exit_codes.1: identity or security prerequisite failed, or unexpected internal error
